payload.title: Public read-only GraphQL for live islands on static pages
payload.description: Pages stay static. Add a public, read-only, rate-limited surface on the CMS app's GraphQL API, scoped to published content only (latest items, search, item metadata), so static pages can host small live islands. M8's static JSON (_data/search-index.json, latest.json) and <papyrus-search> are the starting point. No drafts, no editorial data, nothing writable. Document the guest surface and add a test that unpublished items are invisible.
